hooks.command: f=$(echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -oE '([A-Za-z]:[^"]*|/[^"]*)\.dart' | head -1); if [ -n "$f" ] && [[ "$f" != *.g.dart ]] && [[ "$f" != *.mocks.dart ]]; then cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/frontend" && dart format "$f" 2>&1 | tail -1 && flutter analyze --no-fatal-infos 2>&1 | tail -3; fi
f=$(echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -oE '([A-Za-z]:[^"]*|/[^"]*)\.py' | head -1); if [ -n "$f" ] && [[ "$f" == *functions/* ]]; then python3 -m py_compile "$f" 2>&1 | tail -5; fi

f=$(echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -oE '([A-Za-z]:[^"]*|/[^"]*)firestore\.rules' | head -1); if [ -n "$f" ]; then echo 'REMINDER: firestore.rules changed - run the firestore-rules-check skill or the emulator jest suite (test/firestore-rules) before deploying. Rules bugs here are privilege-escalation risk (team isolation).'; fi
if echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE '\.(g|mocks)\.dart'; then echo 'BLOCK: This is a generated file. Run dart run build_runner build instead of editing directly.' && exit 2; fi
